result.summary: Adds BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to the list of implemented BIPs in doc/bips.md. Bitcoin Core already implements this functionality, merged in PR #13666 for release v0.17.0.
result.problem: doc/bips.md does not document that Bitcoin Core implements BIP 461, leaving the implemented specifications reference incomplete.
evidence: PR description notes that the BIP 461 mailing list discussion explicitly cites Bitcoin Core's implementation merged in #13666 (released in v0.17.0).
result.card: Adds BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to doc/bips.md. Bitcoin Core already implements this signing behavior (merged in #13666 in v0.17.0), but doc/bips.md did not list the formalized BIP specification. This is a documentation-only update.

risk.why: A mistake would only affect documentation text with no impact on node operation.
